meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 实现做完后,Claude 会自己先在真实界面(HTTP、CLI、网页等)上做手动 QA 并留下证据,再只启动一个 gate reviewer 子代理,审计目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏的上下文和 QA 证据,最后给出通过或失败结论。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发;任何一行 QA 失败会直接判 REVIEW FAILED,并跳过 gate reviewer。

howto.what_en: After implementation, Claude runs manual QA on the real surface itself, then spawns one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence, and returns a pass or fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work; any failing QA row ends the review as REVIEW FAILED and skips the gate reviewer.
